name: Basketball Stars

comments.author: CosmicPhoenix99
comments.content: This Basketball Stars game is totally awesome! Playing with my friend is the best, especially featuring legendary basketball players. I love it!

comments.author: SavageKatana_X
comments.content: Wow, never expected such a fun 2-player basketball game like Basketball Stars. The gameplay is smooth, and the competition is fierce! Definitely worth a try.

comments.author: Witcher4Lyfe
comments.content: Playing Basketball Stars with LeBron is kinda crazy, lol! Me and my buddy went at it and it was a blast! You gotta check it out.

comments.author: NoobMaster42
comments.content: Basketball Stars? Well, it's alright. Playing solo is cool, but nothing beats battling it out with a friend. The variety of players is pretty neat too.

comments.author: xX_DarkAura_Xx
comments.content: The graphics are decent in Basketball Stars, but the 2 player mode is where it's at for real. I'm always down to hoop with my friends, any day of the week.

comments.author: PhantomKraken87
comments.content: This game is crazy! I mean, playing with legends like Curry is just too good! Basketball Stars is a must-play game, no cap.

comments.author: NeonRevolver_Y
comments.content: So glad I found this game! Basketball Stars is the perfect game to play with a friend, very good fun!

comments.author: LagWarriorXX
comments.content: Alright, fine, this Basketball Stars is kinda fun, I guess. Playing with friends and facing up against big names is pretty rad.

comments.author: CtrlAltDefeat
comments.content: Basketball Stars is actually way more fun than I thought before. Playing solo or playing with a friend, doesn't matter, It is still great.

comments.author: PotionMishap
comments.content: Is this game about Basketball Stars, the game? Two-player mode is lit, for real! Gotta love trash-talking my friend LOL!

userInputText: Basketball Stars is a 2-player basketball game created by Madpuffers. Shoot b-ball with the likes of LeBron James, James Harden, and Stephen Curry in Basketball Stars! You can play solo or with a friend as a variety of legendary basketball players.
